assumptions.text: Honest headers: every header-hash check `committedBatches[i] == hash` is modelled as committed[i] != 0. A caller passing a wrong header always reverts, so such calls add no states.
commit* parent = lastCommitted. Any other parent reverts at `_batchIndex == lastCommittedBatchIndex` or earlier.
finalizeBatch index = lastFinalized + 1. Other indices revert at `lastFinalizedBatchIndex + 1 == _batchIndex` or earlier.
Proofs submitted to proveState / commitBatchWithProof are valid (mock verifier). Invalid proofs revert.
Deposits, rewards, stakes and slash amounts are omitted. slash is modelled only as deactivating the submitter of record (submitter==1). addSubmitter abstracts re-registration plus re-staking.
commitBatch always attaches one blob at version 1, so blob hash token = 1. commitState carries no blob. Versions and the v2 blob aggregation are covered by the PAR laws.
Hashes and roots are tokens: committed in {0,1}, post state root in {1,2}, and 0 means bytes32(0).
block.timestamp starts at 1 (genesis) and only tick advances it. enqueue uses the current timestamp.
